segments.name: Products
segments.description: Develops and sells perimeter intrusion detection systems, video and security management software, and surveillance solutions for critical infrastructure protection.
segments.evidence: Our products include Video Management Software (VMS), Security Management Software (SMS), Intelligent Video Analytics (IVA) and PIDS products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for security products, software licenses, and services including maintenance contracts and software-related services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates its revenues mainly from: (1) sales of security products; (2) services and maintenance, which are performed either on a fixed-price basis or as time-and-materials based contracts; and (3) software license fees and related services.

changes.text: In 2021, the Projects segment was sold and results classified as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On June 30, 2021, the Projects segment was sold.
